tasks.label: Build & Deploy All Mods
tasks.description: Build available mods and deploy all to RimWorld

tasks.label: Deploy All Mods
args: $steamMods = 'D:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\RimWorld\Mods'; @('MagicFramework', 'MFVanilla', 'AeternusFaith') | ForEach-Object { $mod = $_; $src = "$PSScriptRoot\$mod"; $dst = "$steamMods\$mod"; Write-Host "Deploying $mod..."; if (Test-Path "$src\Assemblies\*.dll") { Copy-Item "$src\Assemblies\*.dll" "$dst\Assemblies\" -Force -Verbose }; if (Test-Path "$src\Defs") { Copy-Item "$src\Defs\*" "$dst\Defs\" -Recurse -Force -Verbose }; if (Test-Path "$src\Textures") { Copy-Item "$src\Textures\*" "$dst\Textures\" -Recurse -Force -Verbose }; Write-Host "✓ Deployed $mod"; }
